# What Vivado 2026.1 made of each design here, on xc7a100tftg256-3: its own
# flow (synth_design, opt_design, place_design, phys_opt_design, route_design,
# write_bitstream), the bitstream decoded through this repository's database
# (`reticle fpga --decode`), and of each slice holding a CARRY4 the features
# of its carry, `PRECYINIT.*` and `CARRY4.*`, one line a slice, sorted, the
# slice's place taken off. `cell` lines are the cells Vivado put on the first
# CARRY4's lane 0, from its own placement (`get_cells -of [get_sites]`).
# tests/fpga_xray_carry_in_vivado.rs says how to read it.
design shared8
  cell A5LUT LUT3
  cell A6LUT LUT5
  slice CARRY4.ACY0 CARRY4.BCY0 CARRY4.CCY0 CARRY4.DCY0 PRECYINIT.AX
  slice CARRY4.ACY0 CARRY4.BCY0 CARRY4.CCY0 PRECYINIT.CIN
